children: Visium Technologies CEO and Chairman Paul R. Taylor resigned effective immediately, and CFO Mark B. Lucky was designated interim principal executive officer.
Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and director
Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer, Secretary and director; interim principal executive officer
Resigned from all Company offices and positions
Disagreement with the Company regarding its operations, policies and practices
Will serve until a Chief Executive Officer is appointed
Has served as CFO, Treasurer, Secretary and director since 2018; previously served as Chairman and CEO through April 27, 2026
Resigned as a director; did not serve on any Board committee
Remains a director; is the Company’s sole director following Taylor’s resignation

No additional compensation for interim role. Remains under his March 28, 2026 Executive Employment Agreement; about $124,800 in accrued, unpaid base salary as of October 30, accruing at $400,000 annually. Delivered a Good Reason notice citing, among other things, unpaid salary and lack of D&O insurance; cure period extended, and he has not resigned.

title: Visium Technologies' Paul Taylor resigns; Mark Lucky becomes interim CEO
